title: Well-posedness for the spatially inhomogeneous Fermi-Dirac-Fokker-Planck equation
summary: This paper is concerned with space inhomogeneous Fermi-Dirac-Fokker-Planck equation posed on a classical kinetic phase space. The nonlinear factor $f(1-f)$ appears both in the transport term and in the collison part of the Fokker-Planck operator, accounting for the exclusion principle of fermions. Solutions are subject to the physical constraint $0\leq f\leq 1$. Previous existing results have mainly been obtained under suitable smallness or close-to-equilibrium assumptions.
